rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: DRIFT RE-CHECK against current §15 wording (fetched via `node curriculum/evals/scripts/rule.js slides 15`, generalised 2026-08-19). Four headings (raw lines21, 31, 40, 45) are plain imperatives/phase-style. The closer 'The slice Claude didn't load' (raw line55) is grammatically a noun phrase with a gapped relative clause ('the slice [that] Claude didn't load'), not an independent subject+predicate assertion like the compendium's two counted exercise declaratives ('Anything can be reverse-engineered', 'There is always a next plausible answer') — it reads under the catalogue-entry-naming-subject carve-out. The rule's binding test is whether 'the header IS the teaching' with 'a label [that] would waste the beat'; here it does not, because the exercise's generalizing claim is carried in the chunk's own bullets (raw lines57-58: 'What you want is the least context that holds exactly what the task needs' / 'The slice Claude didn't load stays real... you choose what fills it'), not left for the header alone to state. Consistent with the compendium's own house-norm measurement (2/108 exercise headings are true declaratives).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Checked every body bullet (raw lines23, 33-34, 42-43, 47, 57-58) against the three classes. None restates a doctrine/law already announced earlier in this body — each states its content for the first time. None is self-referential design commentary about the curriculum's own pedagogy — every bullet describes the student's practice on their own repo, not the training's design choices. The bullet closest to an aphorism kicker is raw line58 ('The slice Claude didn't load stays real. The window holds only so much; going forward, you choose what fills it.'), whose opening clause echoes the chunk's own header (raw line55) — but the bullet earns its slot rather than merely restating it: it adds the claim that the unread content remains consequential ('stays real') plus a forward-looking agency instruction ('you choose what fills it'), neither of which the bare header states. Stays inside the rule.
